title: AIPsychoBench: Understanding the Psychometric Differences between LLMs and Humans
reasoning: AIPsychoBench incorporates and evaluates specific faith-related subcategories within its benchmark, such as 'God's Love' from the Contingencies of Self-Worth Scale (CSWS) and 'Religious Activities' from the Comprehensive Assessment of Basic Interests (CABIN), specifically analyzing linguistic deviations in these metrics.
